reply.answer_text: No. Do not pay. A 'no match' on Confirmation of Payee is treated as a potential fraud indicator. Re-verify the payee details independently before proceeding, and extend the payment hold. The standard hold on first payment to a new account is 2 business days; a manager may extend it if there's a documented reason.
